verdict.rationale: Brave's own API covers each step of the flow. The LLM Context endpoint returns pre-extracted, token-budgeted page content from search results, so no scraping is needed (docs-39, docs-55, docs-58). The Answers endpoint synthesizes grounded answers over single or multiple searches, with an iterative deep-research mode (docs-17, docs-27, docs-62). The summarizer API and the official MCP server expose these tools to agents (docs-15, docs-16). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the deep-research flow, a documented standalone extraction step for arbitrary agent-chosen URLs (extraction is tied to search results), and detail on deep research beyond its streaming requirement.
